prototype: 754 days across eight simulated ATMs tests the pipeline. Treat the scores as a prototype until the same protocol is run on real ATM data.
decision_time: Cutoff day's demand is known. The model forecasts the next seven days.

history.lag_7_14_28: demand on the target date minus 7, 14 and 28 days; these dates are on or before the cutoff
history.rolling: mean and sample standard deviation of 7, 14 and 28 days ending on the cutoff, full windows only

calendar.is_weekend: Saturday or Sunday of the target date
calendar.is_2_4_sat: second or fourth Saturday of the target month
calendar.is_month_end: last three calendar days of the target month
calendar.is_payday: dim_calendar flag; rule legacy-payday-v1 is the 1st, the 15th, and the last weekday
calendar.is_regional_holiday: bank holiday for the ATM's RBI region
calendar.pre_holiday: day before a regional bank holiday, when that day is not itself a holiday
calendar.horizon: 1 to 7, so one history vector is not asked to predict seven dates unlabeled

weather: Excluded. weather_city_daily.csv is the Open-Meteo ERA5 archive retrieved on 2026-10-21, the weather that occurred. No forecast issued on each cutoff was stored.
atm_profile: terminal_id and loc_type are categorical. Each of the eight ATMs has its own location type, so loc_type is an ATM label. Do not read a location-type effect as a result for a larger network.
seasonal_benchmark: mu_i x s_dom from run_simulated._fit_factors, refit on dates through the cutoff. P50/P80/P95 multiply that profile by the ATM's training quantiles of actual/profile. Each training day is used once. seasonal_mean is the profile itself and is the benchmark compared on WAPE and bias.
cycle_quantile_note: Cycle p80 and p95 coverage compare the week's demand with the sum of the seven daily quantile forecasts. Report that sum on its own; it is a different object from the quantile of the seven-day total.
horizon_weekday: Origins advance by 7 days from Sunday 2025-08-31, so each horizon is one weekday in every fold: horizon 1 is Monday and horizon 7 is Sunday. The pooled score still contains an equal number of each weekday.
quantile_monotone_repair: Separate LightGBM quantile fits can cross. After clipping at zero, P80 is raised to P50 and P95 to P80 when a fit crosses. P50 is unchanged. cross_rate is the share of test rows that crossed before that repair.

replenishment.cer70: load = sum of the central daily forecast / 0.70. Central forecast is seasonal_mean or lightgbm P50.
replenishment.sum_daily_p80: load = sum of the seven daily P80 forecasts
replenishment.sum_daily_p95: load = sum of the seven daily P95 forecasts
replenishment.cer: min(actual, load) / load. Dispensed is capped at the planned load. An emergency visit is counted and does not refill this CER.
replenishment.stockout: actual week demand exceeds the planned load
replenishment.visits: one planned visit per cycle; one extra visit when the cycle stocks out. No rupee price per visit.
replenishment.idle_interest_sketch: sum of excess x 0.08 x 7/365. Holds the whole excess for the week. Not a float-day calculation.

bias_sign: (forecast - actual) / actual. Negative means the forecast is low.
